subject: english
stem: The following notice gives details for a planned activity. Which action is planned or required in the full message?
options: show the Local Food Lab ticket at the first door
take photos in the Local Food Lab workshop
keep the Local Food Lab ticket for the last door
leave the Local Food Lab ticket in the first room

optionRationales.reason: show the Local Food Lab ticket at the first door：此項把「keep the Local Food Lab ticket for the last」改成「show the Local Food Lab ticket at the first」。完整訊息指出計畫或要求的行動為「keep the Local Food Lab ticket for the last door」。因此，鎖定證據支持「keep the Local Food Lab ticket for the last door」。

take photos in the Local Food Lab workshop：此項把「keep the Local Food Lab ticket for the last door」改成「take photos in the Local Food Lab workshop」。完整訊息指出計畫或要求的行動為「keep the Local Food Lab ticket for the last door」。因此，鎖定證據支持「keep the Local Food Lab ticket for the last door」。
keep the Local Food Lab ticket for the last door：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。完整訊息指出計畫或要求的行動為「keep the Local Food Lab ticket for the last door」。

leave the Local Food Lab ticket in the first room：此項把「keep the Local Food Lab ticket for the last door」改成「leave the Local Food Lab ticket in the first room」。完整訊息指出計畫或要求的行動為「keep the Local Food Lab ticket for the last door」。因此，鎖定證據支持「keep the Local Food Lab ticket for the last door」。
